Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 renewal: log retention requirement and contract impact

Hi Priya,

We kicked off internal planning for our SOC 2 re-attestation and I have a couple of asks so we can align on the renewal. Our security team confirmed that for our internal audit we need access to three years of platform audit logs (auth/login, admin changes, and system events) and an index mapping for where each evidence artifact lives.

Questions:
- Can Redwood provide a retention extension to 3 years for audit logs (currently 1 year in our contract)?
- If retention needs a contract amendment, can you share an indicative timeline and a draft term we can feed to procurement?
- Can you provide an evidence index (file list + provenance) and a small sample extract so our auditors can validate format?

We are targeting our renewal signature by end of October. If we need an amendment for retention, procurement will need the final language to route to legal. Also, we are open to discussing a committed-capacity uplift if that simplifies the retention SLA and reduces unit costs.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Security Program Manager
ACME Corp

--

Hi Maria,

Thanks for the clear asks — we can support ACME's audit needs and I put together a proposed path below:

1) Retention & term amendment
- We can extend the audit-log retention window to 3 years via a term amendment (addendum to existing MSA).
- Typical timeline: draft amendment in 2 business days, legal review 3–5 business days, DocuSign routing + signatures ~3–7 business days depending on procurement.

2) Evidence index & sample extracts
- Our security team will produce an evidence index (CSV) mapping required evidence types to storage locations and export timestamps. We will also provide a compressed sample of the relevant log lines (sanitized) for auditor validation.
- ETA for first delivery: 48–72 hours after you confirm scope (which event types/tables you need).

3) Commercial options (to simplify retention SLA)
- If ACME is open to a committed-capacity uplift (monthly seat/GPU reserve) we can offer a bundled retention add-on at a discounted rate (we'll credit a portion of the first quarter). I can loop in Karthik to provide a short commercial proposal.

Next steps I propose: 30-minute call to confirm exact event types and to lock the timeline. I can host tomorrow or Friday morning.

Attaching: SOC2-Evidence-Index.csv (stub) and a sample log extract (log-sample-20271012.jsonl.gz) — both are sanitized samples for scoping. Also attaching a very rough draft of the term amendment we plan to use (term-amendment-draft.pdf) so procurement can see the structure.

Best,
